x: Conditions were good and at 5 miles there was a bunch of 8 runners together; Mike Hurd and Don Faircloth (Croydon H), Dave Patterson (TVH), Paul Earles (Windsor S & E), Colin Taylor (Airdale & Spen Valley), Ian Macintosh (Ranelagh), Tom Moore (Liverpool H) and Tom Roden (S.L.H.).
This turned out to be the case with Mike Hurd winning from Dave Patterson and Mike Woods. Pat O'Connor recorded his first Belgrave Championship win with Rex Bale second and Doug Maughan 3rd.
